By Francisco Rodrigues | Edited by Aoyon Ashraf Oct 25, 2026, 11:00 a.m. EDT 3 min read Make preferred on Share Share this article Copy link X icon X (Twitter) LinkedIn Facebook Email Make preferred on Summary Show Latvia could have rules for tokenizing real-world assets in the first half of 2027, with commercial property a possible start, its economics minister said. Government bonds are on the “priority list” and could be tokenized in the first part of next year, Viktors Valainis said, without giving issuance details. A legal assessment due Oct. 1 is “still ongoing,” and Valainis’s party won no seats in this month’s election as Latvia forms a new government.
